title: Universal Map layer.json
description: See docs/json-reference.md for the full field-by-field reference. Mirrors the runtime checks in src/engine/manifests/layer-manifest.ts (validateLayerManifest) - keep both in sync when either changes.

kind.description: "point": L.geoJSON, clustered if style.cluster. "heatmap": leaflet.heat, Point geometry only. "line"/"polygon"/"boundary": L.geoJSON with fill+border style.

source.description: "geojson": a single GeoJSON file, fetched whole. "geojson-sharded": several GeoJSON files, fetched and concatenated. ("api" is a reserved, not-yet-implemented source type - not accepted by runtime validation yet.)

defaultVisibility.description: Declared but not read by any code yet - isActiveOn filtering always applies the same way regardless of this value.

taxonomy.description: Filter dimensions this layer contributes to the right-hand filters panel.

id.description: Filter-dimension identifier, the key used in activeFilters. If two layers declare the same id with a different label, the first one processed wins.

label.description: Label shown in the right-hand filters panel.

field.description: Dotted path inside the feature's properties, e.g. "properties.category".

hierarchical.description: Declared but not read by any code yet.

defaultIcon.description: Icon for values with no entry in icons.

regionRole.description: If "boundary", this layer's features participate in findContainingRegions() as administrative boundaries with temporal validity.

style.description: Which keys are read depends on kind. point: cluster (boolean), icon (string). line/polygon/boundary: color, weight, fillColor, fillOpacity (CSS color / number).

showInSearch.description: false excludes this layer's features entirely from the left panel. Defaults to true.

showInInfo.description: Declared but not read by any code yet.

infoFields.description: Extra properties shown on the selection card when a feature from this layer is selected.

type.description: Defaults to "text". "link"/"image" only render as / when the value is an http(s):/mailto: URL.

showByDefault.description: false makes the layer opt-in, hidden until toggled on via the layer control's "Map details" group. Defaults to true.
